Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 1  
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer agent made an initial mistake in Step 1 by not identifying the correct film "Der Blindgänger" (2004) directed by Bernd Sahling, and instead erroneously selecting "Blindgänger" (2024) directed by Kerstin Polte. This misstep led to the entire process being focused on the wrong film and director, which invalidated all subsequent efforts to determine if the directors of the two films were from the same country. The WebSurfer agent failed to properly disambiguate the films based on the title, year, and context, which should have been a critical part of the task.
